steps: Find the common curriculum completion rules for your admission year.
For a course created after you enrolled, check whether its area exists in those rules.
If the area is absent, expect only general common-curriculum credit, not the area requirement.
If the course is designated same/substitute, it counts under the old course's pre-revision area.
summary: Courses count by your admission-year rules; new courses outside those areas earn only general credit.

original.text: 2025학년도 교양교육과정 개편에 따른 공통교육과정 교과목의 영역 인정 기준을 아래와 같이 안내합니다.
1. 교과목의 영역 인정 여부는 학생의 입학년도 공통교육과정 이수규정을 기준으로 판단함
2. 학생의 입학년도 이후 신설된 교과목을 이수한 경우
가. 입학학년도의 이수규정에 해당 영역이 존재하면 해당 영역 이수학점으로 인정
나. 입학학년도의 이수규정에 해당 영역이 존재하지 않으면, 영역 필수 이수에는 포함되지 않으며, 전체 공통교육과정(교양) 학점으로만 인정
※ 동일·대체 교과목으로 지정되어 있는 경우에는 신규 교과목을 수강해도 동일·대체 지정된 기존 교과목의 개편 이전 영역 이수학점으로 인정

english: The criteria for recognising the area (category) of 공통교육과정 (common curriculum, i.e. general education) courses, following the 2025 academic year reform of the general education curriculum, are announced as follows.
1. Whether a course is recognised for a given area is decided based on the common curriculum completion rules of the student's year of admission.
2. If a student has completed a course that was newly created after the student's year of admission:
가. If the corresponding area exists in the completion rules of the student's year of admission, the course is recognised as credits completed in that area.

나. If the corresponding area does not exist in the completion rules of the student's year of admission, the course is not counted toward the required credits for any area, and is recognised only as credits toward the total common curriculum (general education) credits.

※ If a new course is designated as an equivalent or substitute course (동일·대체 교과목) for an existing course, taking the new course is recognised as credits in the area that the designated existing course belonged to before the reform.
